items.name: Spec Compliance
items.note: All four criteria met: scaffold fixture carries the block, adopt fixture gets it, a second run changes nothing, empty profile writes a none-declared line.

items.name: Error Handling
items.note: Unresolvable profile exits 2, damaged markers or missing file exit 3 without writing, bad rules are left out and counted in the block, never fatal.

items.name: Security Basics
items.note: Profile text is flattened to one line and comment delimiters are neutralised so it cannot close the markers; no shell, paths only from the project root.

items.name: Test Quality
items.note: 17 shared tests (placement paths, idempotency, CRLF, damaged markers, injection, legacy, invalid-only) and 4 adopt tests through the real generator.

items.name: Performance Basics
items.note: One file read and at most one write per run.

items.name: Naming & Structure
items.note: New tool under 300 lines; adopt files at their bloat ceiling were kept net-small (artifact_writer untouched, generator +2 lines).

items.name: Affected Boundaries
items.note: Producer: profile JSON (BOM, non-ASCII, CRLF conventions.md); consumer: render CLI; two probes run through the real CLI, no finding on the second, asymptote reached.

items.name: Test Hygiene Probe
items.note: tmp_path only, no sleeps, no shared state.
